market_wrap.text: The Nifty fell 277 points (1.07%) to 25,607 and the Sensex 989 points to 83,339, snapping a four-week winning run, as Brent crude neared $98, the rupee weakened toward ₹92.9 per dollar and proposed US tariffs on trading partners including India weighed; IT led the losses (HCL Tech, Infosys and TCS down about 2.5–2.8%). Broader markets held up, with the Nifty Smallcap 100 up 0.56%.

reasons.reason: Silver extended its rebound from near 14-month lows: MCX silver was up about 5–6% to around ₹1.53–1.54 lakh/kg in the afternoon and COMEX silver about 10% higher, on value buying, a recovery in Asian tech stocks and thin Thanksgiving trade.

Gold rebounded with silver: MCX December gold rose about 3% to roughly ₹1.26 lakh per 10g at the day's high, on value buying after recent lows; Upstox noted the December Fed meeting and sticky US inflation could cap gains.

These are 26 November NAVs (today's were not yet published), reflecting Thursday's silver rebound: MCX December silver rose about 2–3% to around ₹1.46 lakh/kg on value buying near one-year lows and steady US Treasury yields. Silver rose further today (Silver BeES +4.2%), which should show in the next NAVs.

outlook.view: Silver and gold have rebounded for two days from near one-year lows on value buying (Silver BeES +4.2% and Gold BeES +2.8% on 27 November), but stronger-than-expected US inflation has kept a December US rate rise priced in, which has been the main pressure on bullion.
outlook.watch: The 8–9 December Fed decision and the dollar.

outlook.view: They have outperformed large caps this year, but lagged today's bank-led rally (Nifty Smallcap 100 −0.13%) and tend to fall harder when rates rise or foreign investors sell.
outlook.watch: RBI decision on 4 December and foreign investor flows.

outlook.view: Indian IT services stocks led the 27 November fall (HCL Tech, Infosys and TCS down about 2.5–2.8%) on proposed US tariffs on trading partners including India; Geojit also flagged that a revival in Asian AI stocks could divert flows away from India.
outlook.watch: US tariff decisions and December-quarter results from January.

outlook.view: Record copper prices drove Hindustan Copper's profit surge, but copper has since slipped to a five-month low on a strong dollar and weak China data, dragging metal stocks.
outlook.watch: Global copper prices and the dollar.

outlook.view: The RBI is in a tightening phase, which tends to lower bond prices in the short term and raise yields on new bonds.
